BrochureContent.Content: A superb quality detached spacious four-bedroomed residence situated in a stunning location on the R663 Lisvernane -Bansha Road just outside the village of Lisvernane,10 Km Tipperary Town, within easy commuting distance of M8 Cork- Dubiln motorway at Cahir and 15 mins drive Limerick Junction Railway station. Nestled in the heart of the scenic Glen of Aherlow the property has views of the Galtee Mountains in the foreground and is a short distance from popular walking trails in the Glen, the property presents a turnkey opportunity in a highly sought after location. The residence is presented in pristine condition and the finishes and setting can only be fully appreciated by an inspection of the property.

The residence extends to c.1850 sq ft and stands on a mature fully landscaped  site. The property is an ideal family home providing generous living space and  amenity space for an active family, with four well-proportioned bedrooms (3 No. en suite), Sittingroom, Kitchen, diningroom and utility.The grounds are fully landscaped with a large concrete yard to the side and rear with Garage, entire surrounded by mature hedging.In addition the property has a bank of 182 solar panels ( 16KW battery storage )on site providing net zero electricity bills annually.

Set in the stunning Glen of Aherlow, this spacious four-bedroom family home enjoys breathtaking views of the surrounding countryside and mountains. Combining generous living space with a peaceful rural setting, it offers the perfect opportunity to enjoy family life in one of Tipperary's most scenic locations
